about.description: Lartigue Fresh Seafood is a family-owned business that started in 1979 when Bubba and Uncle Larry opened their first seafood market on Old Shell Road in Mobile, Alabama. They expanded to Gulf Shores in 1988 and settled in Orange Beach in 1999. For over 40 years, they've been crafting original spice blends and signature sauces with time-tested family recipes, serving the Gulf Coast community with fresh seafood and quality products.
about.elevator_pitch: A family-owned Gulf Coast seafood market offering fresh seafood, original spice blends, and signature sauces since 1979.
about.vibe: Casual, family-friendly seafood market with a strong Gulf Coast tradition and passion for quality ingredients
about.insider_tip: They offer catering services for weddings, birthdays, holidays, and corporate gatherings with pickup from their Orange Beach location.
